## Project Hygiene Checklist
- [ ] I have not used greedy commands like `git add .` or `git add -A`.
- [ ] I have verified that all modified `.md` files contain strictly **ZERO** typographic em-dashes (`U+2014`) and **ZERO** en-dashes (`U+2013`).
- [ ] Files remain within their respective line ceilings (95 to 195 lines).
- [ ] All tests or build scripts pass cleanly (`npm run build` or `npm test`).
